source: Independent verifier pass over the graph backfill (2026-10-08), cross-checked against the live files

entities.name: description override gap
entities.description: graph-assemble.mjs sets a node description only at creation and fills blanks afterwards, so a wrong description cannot be corrected by adding a new episode - it can only be changed by editing the original episode, which the store's append-only contract forbids. No override map, no last-writer-wins, no superseded_by for descriptions. Node type is create-only for the same reason: UNKNOWN upgrades to a hint type, any other mismatch logs TYPE-CONFLICT and is ignored

entities.name: stale-by-supersession descriptions
entities.description: Node descriptions that were accurate when written and are now outdated rather than wrong - they are shadowed by an invalidated edge, not by a correction. The Termux environment summary ('Android terminal hosting the entire dev setup') is this kind: true for Aug 2026, superseded by the 2026-10-06 invalidation, not an error needing correction
